purpose: Machine-readable UAT manifest for evaluating whether VerityDAM MCP is ready for digital-marketing agents.

assertions: results is not empty
results[0] matches expected product identity
results[0].product_safety.safe_for_exact_product_use is true
no wrong sibling model is labelled exact-safe

cases.goal: Wrong-but-visually-similar product does not pass as exact product.
assertions: wrong asset is not exact-product safe
fit_grade <= 1 when product mismatch is material
product_match.matched is false or rationale explicitly rejects identity

cases.goal: Absent products do not produce hallucinated exact matches.
assertions: no result claims safe exact-product identity for the absent SKU/model

cases.goal: Clearly irrelevant imagery is rejected by image-fit.
assertions: fit_grade <= 1

cases.goal: Never-used qualifying creative beats recently used creative.
cases.setup: Use a product family with at least two qualifying candidates. Record one candidate on the target test channel before the second find call.
assertions: best_pick is not null
recent candidate is marked already_used_recently
a qualifying never-used candidate wins while one exists
best_pick.asset_id == ranked_candidates[0].asset_id

cases.goal: All-recent candidate pool falls back to LRU rather than null.
cases.setup: Make every qualifying candidate recent on the same dedicated UAT channel with distinct timestamps.
assertions: best_pick is not null
best_pick has the oldest last_used_at among qualifying recent candidates
best_pick is null only when no candidate meets min_fit_grade
when best_pick exists it equals ranked_candidates[0]
selection order is not demoted by usage recency

cases.goal: Usage freshness is isolated by channel.
cases.setup: Record target asset on facebook, then evaluate/search same asset for website.
assertions: facebook view marks the asset recent
website view does not mark facebook usage as recent
website total_usage_count excludes facebook-only usage

cases.goal: Usage is recorded only after external publish succeeds.
cases.setup: Run one simulated publish failure and one simulated publish success in the agent layer.
assertions: failed publish causes zero media_record_usage calls
successful publish causes exactly one media_record_usage call after success

cases.goal: Asset visibility respects role and permission boundaries.
cases.setup: Use one public asset and one internal-only asset with callers of different roles where supported.
assertions: public-only search returns no internal asset
unauthorized caller cannot retrieve restricted content

cases.goal: Pending uploads cannot leak into approved marketing search.
assertions: new upload appears pending
new upload is absent from approved search/list before approval
fit_grade == 0
response contains actionable manual-review guidance

cases.goal: Sequential campaign posts use the available creative pool before repeating.
cases.setup: Use a dedicated UAT channel and a product family with at least three qualifying creatives. Run ten sequential find -> simulated publish success -> record cycles.
assertions: no creative repeats while a qualifying never-used candidate remains in the returned candidate pool
after exhaustion repeated creatives follow oldest-last-used preference
every successful cycle has one corresponding usage row

cases.goal: Mixed product and scene prompt preserves product identity while matching context.

input_template.post_text: {{exact_product}} trên cửa chính căn hộ hiện đại, phong cách tối giản

assertions: best_pick is exact-product safe
best_pick.fit_grade >= 2
rationale is consistent with requested scene

cases.goal: MCP activity is auditable without persisting sensitive payloads.
cases.setup: Invoke a read tool and a controlled write, then inspect public.mcp_tool_call_log with operational access.
assertions: tool calls are present in audit log
actor identity is attributable
raw base64 and sensitive tokens are absent from stored payload
business call remains successful if audit write is unavailable
